# Houston Astros
## News •
The Astros have won two World Series titles, in 2017 and 2022, and have been members of both the National League (NL) and the American League (AL).

The Astros have won two World Series titles (2017 and 2022).

They have won two World Series titles, in 2017 and 2022.

**Houston Astros**, American professional [baseball](https://www.britannica.com/sports/baseball) team based in [Houston](https://www.britannica.com/place/Houston) that has won two [World Series](https://www.britannica.com/sports/World-Series) titles (2017 and 2022).

web.description:
# Astros History | Timeline
#### 2010s
##### 2022
The Astros won their second World Series title in six years, beating the Phillies in six games to polish off a dominant 11-2 run in the postseason that came on the heels of a 106-win regular season.
